Nu Holdings Ltd. Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results

Sao Paulo, May 13, 2026 — Nu Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NU) today announced financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Revenue reached $3.7 billion, up 35% year-over-year on an FX-neutral basis, and the company added 4.6 million customers in the quarter, ending at 124 million. Net income was $720 million. Monthly average revenue per active customer expanded to $12.1.

First Quarter 2026 Highlights:
- Customer growth: 124.0 million customers, up 17% YoY
- Gross profit of $1.7 billion, gross margin 46%

MercadoLibre, Inc.
Letter to Shareholders — Fourth Quarter 2025

Dear Shareholders,

We closed 2025 with strong momentum across commerce and fintech. In the fourth quarter, ended December 31, 2025, gross merchandise volume grew 29% FX-neutral, while Mercado Pago's total payment volume rose 41%. Credit portfolio reached $7.8 billion with an NPL ratio improving quarter over quarter. We continued to invest in logistics: same-day or next-day delivery now covers 83% of shipments.

Our strategy remains unchanged: deepen the ecosystem, expand credit prudently, and compound the network effects of our marketplace across Latin America. Below we review the quarter in detail, segment by segment, and outline our investment priorities for 2026.
